IDENTITY.biggestGap: No Identity Concept Territory — intelligence may collapse to style/direction without concept formation layer
IDENTITY.nextRequiredCapability: Identity concept formation + identity system compiler (verbal/visual/motion identity as governed system)

CONTENT_CREATIVE.biggestGap: No topic strategy, content calendar, campaign continuity, or performance learning loop
CONTENT_CREATIVE.nextRequiredCapability: Content planning engine — who/what decides what the brand says next

SITE.biggestGap: Hero proof → full site bridge missing; Composer would become creative director for remaining pages
SITE.nextRequiredCapability: Page families, layout grammar, design tokens, surface-specific briefs before implementation

EXPERIENCE.biggestGap: Page-centric visual metaphor; weak interaction/IA/conversion architecture; solving site architecture problems
EXPERIENCE.nextRequiredCapability: Experience behavior model + interaction architecture separate from visual proof composition

APPLICATION_PRODUCT.biggestGap: Product Expression layer entirely missing between intelligence and implementation
APPLICATION_PRODUCT.nextRequiredCapability: Product Expression architecture (roles, loops, state, workflows, business rules)

MOTION.biggestGap: Motion exists as intent/lineage types only — decorative potential, not medium discipline
MOTION.nextRequiredCapability: Motion grammar, transition system, reduced-motion contract, motion asset production

PHYSICAL_EXPERIENCE.nextRequiredCapability: Defer until digital disciplines mature; capture physical intent in intelligence only

WORLD.biggestGap: Contracts describe worlds but cannot form them — missing presence, economy, moderation, sync domains
WORLD.nextRequiredCapability: World blocker domain research before any runtime formation
